articles.title: PM Modi inaugurates refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Balotra, Rajasthan
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi dedicated a Rs 80,000 crore Greenfield Refinery-cum-Petrochemical Complex developed as a joint venture between HPCL and the Rajasthan Government to the nation.

articles.title: PM Modi to embark on three-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi is set to visit Indonesia (July 6-8), Australia (July 8-10), and New Zealand (July 10-11) to deepen bilateral partnerships and engage with Indian diaspora communities.

articles.title: PM Modi and Japanese PM Takaichi inaugurate Maruti Suzuki's Kharkhoda plant
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi virtually inaugurated Maruti Suzuki India's Rs 35,000 crore advanced vehicle manufacturing facility at IMT Kharkhoda in Haryana.

articles.title: India-Japan sign agreements on economic security, AI, defence
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi and Japanese PM Takaichi signed agreements on economic security, artificial intelligence, defence, and health sectors during the India-Japan Joint Economic Forum.

articles.title: PM Modi holds bilateral talks with Japanese PM Takaichi at Hyderabad House
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi held bilateral talks with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi at the Hyderabad House to deepen India-Japan Special Strategic and Global Partnership.
